downloadPage.title: Download Smoco Desktop
downloadPage.subtitle: Two builds available — Full (v1.2.0) and Lite (v1.2.1). Pick what you need; older versions are also available.

full.desc: Bundles the local Whisper model for offline use; also supports Smoco cloud ASR. Best for offline or maximum-accuracy needs.

lite.desc: Calls the Smoco cloud ASR only — very lightweight. Requires network and a Smoco account; no local Whisper. v1.2.1 adds auto-reconnect on drop & one-click default config.

overview.title: Overview
overview.content: Smoco Desktop is a Windows desktop app that transcribes system audio (browsers, meeting apps) in real time and supports LLM translation. The core is built with PyQt6 GUI + Whisper API/Local Whisper + LLM translation.

features.title: Core features
items: Real-time transcription: 16kHz mono S16LE, via Whisper API or Local Whisper NPU (OpenVINO-genai)
Real-time translation: LLM async translation with previous N entries as context
Smart VAD chunking: 4 tunable parameters
History browser: session/entry two-level, paginated, with detail and txt/md export
Application logs: in-app viewer, file dropdown switching
Full keyboard control: 15+ shortcuts

data.title: Data storage
data.content: All transcription and translation data lives under ~/.smoco/:
items: settings.json — user settings (servers, LLM, VAD params, etc.)
logs/gui_YYYYMMDD.log — application logs (10MB rotation)
data/YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS/ — one directory per session, containing entry_*.json + translate_*.json + metadata.json

build.title: Packaging
build.content: Smoco Desktop is packaged with PyInstaller; build.bat automates main app + whisper-npu-api secondary packaging.

items: Smoco STT now auto-reconnects and resumes recognition session on network drop, with UI toast notifications
LLM & Smoco STT now ship with default config — auto-filled on first launch; one-click restore via "Use Default" button
Fixed table row text clipping at the bottom of the transcript view
Integrated direct Smoco cloud ASR API (socket.io streaming) — transcribe without any local Whisper
Live interim results stream in, final results commit; close is blocked while transcribing; Smoco account is validated on startup
Ships in two builds: Full (with local Whisper model, ~1.4GB) and Lite (Smoco cloud ASR only, ~91MB, lightweight)
Timestamps now use the server SRT timeline; ASR results are saved to history
Microphone capture: device selection now supports choosing a microphone as the audio source (for transcribing your own voice)
Currently microphone and speaker are mutually exclusive (one at a time); simultaneous dual-stream will come in a later version
Local Whisper: v3-turbo model now selectable (small / large-v3-turbo in settings)
UI locked to light theme, no longer follows Windows dark mode
Core transcription + translation (remote Whisper + LLM translation)
Local Whisper NPU (PyInstaller secondary packaging of whisper-npu-api.exe, cross-machine zero-dependency)
Transcription history (session/entry two-level + pagination + txt/md export)
Application log viewer (in-app)
Full shortcut coverage (15+ operations)
Accessibility (accessibleName)
Toast notifications, global QSS styling
CN/JP/EN trilingual with instant switch
Windows self-contained distribution (~770MB zip)
